182.evidence: From 2017 to 2019, Zilis served as a project director for Tesla, Inc.'s Autopilot product and chip design team.

886.evidence: As part of the case files disclosed by Musk's lawyers in federal court in November 2025, Altman was shown to have reached out to Shivon Zilis on February 9, 2023, asking her advice about whether to publicly praise Musk on X, which he later did.
